notes.title: pay a visit to + 地方
the reason for + N / the reason why + 子句
notes.content: 分別接名詞與完整子句，說明「……的原因」。例：Nobody knows the reason why the lights went out.

notes.title: make a will
notes.content: 立遺囑。例：The lawyer advised him to make a will.

notes.title: be high in + 成分
notes.content: 表示「富含某種成分」。例：Beans are high in protein and fiber.

notes.title: remain 作「仍保持是」解的句型
notes.content: remain 作「仍保持是」解時，之後須接名詞或形容詞作補語，例：remain a puzzle（仍一直是個謎）、remain healthy（保持健康）。

notes.title: from time to time
notes.content: 偶爾、不時。例：I still visit my elementary school from time to time.

notes.title: stress sb out
notes.content: 使某人壓力過大／焦慮不安。

notes.title: get sb sth = get sth for sb
used to V
notes.content: 過去經常（但現在不再）做……

notes.title: keep sth in order
notes.content: 把某事物整理得井然有序。例：Peter always keeps his room in order.（彼得總是把房間整理得井然有序。）

notes.title: grow up
notes.content: 長大。例：Lawrence wants to be a pianist when he grows up.（勞倫斯長大後想做一名鋼琴家。）

notes.title: give sb sth / give sth to sb
notes.content: 雙受詞句型；物品可直接放在人後，也可用 to 改寫。例：Mina gave her brother a card. = Mina gave a card to her brother.

notes.title: spread sth (out)
notes.content: 把某物攤開來；把身體某部位伸展開來。

notes.title: since then
notes.content: 從那時起，常與現在完成式搭配。例：We met in fifth grade and have been friends since then.

notes.title: situation 常與介詞 in 並用
notes.content: 本字常與介詞 in 並用。

notes.title: catch fire
notes.content: 著火。例：Paper catches fire easily.（紙張很容易著火。）

notes.title: between A and B
notes.content: 在 A 與 B 之間。

notes.title: one...another...
notes.content: 表示「一個……，另一個……」，後者通常是不特定的另一個。例：One guest ordered soup, and another chose salad.

notes.title: meet sb's expectations
notes.content: 符合某人的期望。同義說法：live up to sb's expectations；measure up to sb's expectations。

notes.title: use sth to V
notes.content: 用某物來做某事。例：We use this app to record new vocabulary.

notes.title: lead / live a(n) + adj. + life
notes.content: 過著某種生活。例：After retiring, they lived a quiet life by the sea.

notes.title: the center of...
notes.content: ……的中心點／中央。例：Wall Street has become the center of business in New York City.（華爾街已成為紐約市的商業中心。）

notes.title: cancel an order
notes.content: 取消訂單。例：Carl told the manager he wanted to cancel his order.（卡爾告訴經理他想取消他的訂單。）

notes.title: sb’s return to / from + 地方
notes.content: 某人回來某地／某人從某地回來。

notes.title: the head of + 組織／部門
notes.content: 表示「……的主管或領導人」。例：She became the head of the research department.

notes.title: sb's mind is a blank ＝ sb's mind goes blank
bring sb up / bring up sb
be low in + 成分
notes.content: 表示「某種成分含量低」。例：This soup is low in salt.

notes.title: one of the all-time greats
notes.content: 史上最傑出的人物之一。例：Many fans consider her one of the all-time greats in tennis.

notes.title: for 與 because 表原因
notes.content: for 作連接詞時較書面，通常接在主要子句後補充理由；because 可置於主要子句前或後，直接回答原因。例：We went inside, for the wind was getting stronger.

notes.title: base A on / upon B
notes.content: A 根據 B 為基礎

notes.title: raise a family
notes.content: 表示「養家、扶養孩子」。例：They worked hard to raise their family.

notes.title: note (that)...
notes.content: 注意到……。例：I noted that Sharon didn't feel well today.（我注意到雪倫今天不太舒服。）

notes.title: in no time
notes.content: 很快地、轉眼間。例：With everyone helping, the room was clean in no time.

notes.title: run away (from...)
notes.content: （從……）逃走。例：Little Billy ran away from the big dog.（小比利逃離那隻大狗。）

notes.title: It appears that...
notes.content: 似乎……。＝ It seems that...。例：It appears to me that something is wrong with the plane's engine.（我感覺飛機的引擎似乎有點問題。）

notes.title: for one thing,... for another,...
notes.content: 首先／一方面……；再者／另一方面……。

notes.title: while sth away / while away sth
alert
notes.content: be on the alert for ...；be alert to ...；alert sb to sth = awaken sb to sth。

notes.title: get + 形容詞
notes.content: 表示「逐漸變得……」。例：The nights are getting colder.

notes.title: go + adj.
notes.content: 連綴動詞表「變成」，後接形容詞作主詞補語；如 go bad / sour（食物腐敗）。

notes.title: order sb to V
notes.content: 命令某人做……。例：Don't order me to do this or that.（別命令我做這做那的。）

notes.title: turn into / turn A into B
notes.content: turn into 是變成；turn A into B 是把 A 變成 B。例：The rain turned into snow, turning the road into ice.

notes.title: body temperature / body language
notes.content: 分別表示「體溫／肢體語言」。例：Her body language showed that she felt uncomfortable.

notes.title: little 作形容詞
notes.content: 表「不多的」時，其後接不可數名詞。

notes.title: refer to + N
notes.content: 可表示「提到、指的是、查閱」。例：The word “they” refers to the two visitors.

notes.title: from time to time = at times = sometimes = on occasion = occasionally
take sb's order
notes.content: 接受某人的點餐。例：The waiter came to take my order.（服務生過來幫我點餐。）

notes.title: be particular about... = be picky / choosy about...
look like
notes.content: 看起來像。例：That cloud looks like a rabbit.

notes.title: leave for + 地方 = set off for + 地方 = head to / for + 地方 = depart for + 地方
make a living
notes.content: 表示「謀生、賺取生活所需」。例：She makes a living by designing websites.

notes.title: on the / one's way to + 地方
spread A on B = spread B with A
notes.content: 把 A 塗抹在 B 上。

notes.title: get + 人 + 事物 / get + 事物 + for + 人
notes.content: 表示「替某人取得或購買某物」。例：Could you get me a bottle of water?

notes.title: in a low voice / be in a low mood
notes.content: 分別表示「低聲地／情緒低落」。例：He answered in a low voice because the baby was sleeping.

notes.title: at the cost of...
notes.content: 以……的代價。例：Roger transformed the business at the cost of his health.（羅傑犧牲了健康來改變公司。）

notes.title: live 的兩種讀音
notes.content: 動詞 live /lɪv/ 表生活、居住；形容詞 live /laɪv/ 表現場的、活的。例：We live nearby and watched the live broadcast.

notes.title: show 的節目與放映用法
notes.content: 名詞 show 可指節目；動詞 show 可指電影上映。例：That talk show airs after the new film is shown.

notes.title: go for a walk / drive
notes.content: 表示「去散步／開車兜風」。例：Dad went for a walk after dinner.

notes.title: though 與 but
notes.content: 延續 p188：Though 作連接詞表「雖然」時，不可再與 but 並用。

notes.title: come from + 地方／背景
notes.content: 表示「來自……」。例：This tradition comes from a small village in Italy.

notes.title: depart
notes.content: depart for + 地點 = set out for + 地點 = leave for + 地點。

notes.title: witness 搭配
notes.content: a witness to sth：是某事的證人；bear witness to …：為…作證。

notes.title: make reference to...
notes.content: 提到；言及……；= refer to...；= mention...。

notes.title: need to V
notes.content: 需要／必須做……。例：Jackson needs help with his homework.（傑克森的家庭作業需要協助。）

notes.title: an approach to + N/V-ing
notes.content: 處理某事的方法；to 是介系詞，後接名詞或動名詞。例：The school adopted a new approach to teaching science.

notes.title: take place
notes.content: 發生；舉行，主詞通常是事件或活動。例：The science fair will take place next Friday.

notes.title: once + 子句
notes.content: 表示「一旦／一……就……」，引導時間副詞子句；未來語境中的 once 子句通常用現在式。例：Once the rain stops, we will leave.

notes.title: a way to V
notes.content: 做某事的方法。例：Reading aloud is a good way to improve pronunciation.

notes.title: inform sb of sth
notes.content: 通知某人某事。同義：notify sb of sth。

notes.title: come across sb/sth
notes.content: 偶遇某人／偶然發現某物。

notes.title: be unique to + 地方
notes.content: 為某地方所獨有。同義說法：be native to + 地方；be indigenous to + 地方。

notes.title: food for thought
notes.content: 表示「發人深省、值得仔細思考的事」。例：The documentary gave us plenty of food for thought.

notes.title: reach a new low
notes.content: 表示數值「降到新低」，也可指表現或行為「跌至新低點」。例：Temperatures reached a new low last night.

notes.title: while 子句簡化為 while + V-ing
notes.content: 副詞子句與主要子句主詞相同且為主動語態時，可刪除副詞子句主詞並將動詞改為 V-ing。例：While walking home, Mia listened to a podcast.

notes.title: and the like = and so on
head out
notes.content: 出發、動身外出。例：We headed out before sunrise to avoid the heat.

notes.title: even if 與 even though
notes.content: even if 表假設「即使」；even though 表已知事實「雖然」。例：Even if it rains, we’ll go. Even though it rained, we went.

notes.title: public opinion
notes.content: 民意，公眾輿論。例：Public opinion is in favor of the candidate.（民意支持這位候選人。）

notes.title: have a good knowledge of... = have a good understanding of...
in person
notes.content: 表示「親自、本人到場」，不是透過網路或他人。例：You must collect the certificate in person.

notes.title: roll out + 產品／服務
notes.content: 表示「正式推出新產品、服務或方案」。例：The company will roll out its new payment system next month.

notes.title: sick / annual leave；take leave
notes.content: leave 作不可數名詞指休假。例：She is on sick leave and will take annual leave next month.

notes.title: in order to V
notes.content: 為了做……。例：Fred leaves home at 7 a.m. in order to get to work on time.（為了能準時上班，佛萊德早上 7 點離開家裡。）

notes.title: (That's) a likely story!
notes.content: 說得倒像是真的一樣／聽起來像真的一樣

notes.title: 關係代名詞 + 插入語 + V
notes.content: 可在 who／which 後插入 I think、I believe 等評論語；真正的主詞動詞關係仍屬於外層關係子句。例：Mia is the student who I believe can lead the team.

notes.title: urge sb to + V
notes.content: 激勵某人做……；= call on sb to + V。

notes.title: come to a close
notes.content: 表示「結束、告一段落」。例：The summer festival came to a close at midnight.

notes.title: be one of the all-time greats
notes.content: 有史以來最偉大的人之一。

notes.title: and so forth = and so on = and the like = etc
man 表「人類」
notes.content: 作總稱時僅用單數，且不加冠詞。

notes.title: a guide dog = a seeing-eye dog
Never put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
a mere + 數字
notes.content: 僅僅若干……；= merely + 數字；= only + 數字。

notes.title: make + 受詞 + 原形動詞
notes.content: 使役結構，表示「使／迫使某人或某物做……」。例：The funny video made everyone laugh.

notes.title: as：像（＝ like）
notes.content: 作連接詞表比擬，語氣近似 like，與既有「當……時」「因為……」兩筆 note 是同一 as 的不同義項。例：The house looks exactly as it did when I was a child.（這棟房子看起來就像我小時候所看到的那樣。）

notes.title: leave for + 地方
notes.content: 動身前往某地。例：Our train leaves for Tainan at noon.

notes.title: dwell on ...
notes.content: *vi.* 居住；dwell–dwelt/dwelled–dwelt/dwelled：dwell in ... = reside in ...、dwell on ...；dwelling 住所。

notes.title: get 表「理解」
notes.content: 作此義時，時態上不可使用現在進行式。

notes.title: find sb/sth + adj.
notes.content: 認為或發現某人／某物具有某種狀態。例：I found the instructions confusing at first.

notes.title: once upon a time
notes.content: （故事開頭）很久以前。例：Once upon a time, here lived a beautiful elf.（很久以前，這裡住著一個漂亮的小精靈。）

notes.title: have no option
notes.content: have no option / choice / alternative but to V：除了…之外別無選擇。

notes.title: have problems / difficulty + V-ing = have a hard time + V-ing
change A into B
notes.content: 把 A 變成 B = transform A into B = turn A into B。

notes.title: take in + 風景／景象
notes.content: 觀看並欣賞眼前的景色或事物。例：We stopped at the top of the hill to take in the view.

notes.title: as a matter of fact / in fact
notes.content: 事實上，用來補充或修正資訊。例：I thought he was new; in fact, he has worked here for years.

notes.title: bring sb up
notes.content: 養育某人；常用被動 be brought up。例：She was brought up by her grandparents.

notes.title: take sb/sth to + 地方
notes.content: 帶某人或某物去某地。例：Could you take this package to the front desk?

notes.title: for real
notes.content: 真正的；真實的。例：I've just won the lottery! For real!（我剛中樂透了！是真的！）

notes.title: grace
notes.content: with good grace；have the grace to + V；grace sb with your presence。

notes.title: come up with + 想法／方案
notes.content: 表示「想出、提出……」。例：The students came up with a clever solution.

notes.title: basic / daily needs
notes.content: 基本需求／日需品。例：Housing and food are basic needs.（吃住是基本需求。）

notes.title: get 表示「理解」
notes.content: 口語中 get 可表示「聽懂、理解」；這個意思通常不用進行式。例：I understand the words, but I don't get the joke.

notes.title: fashion A out of B
notes.content: 用 B 製造出 A

notes.title: be important to + 人
notes.content: 表示某人主觀上「重視……」。例：Spending time with family is important to me.

notes.title: oppose + N/V-ing
notes.content: 反對……；= be opposed to + N/V-ing；= object to + N/V-ing。

notes.title: stretch one's legs
notes.content: （站起來走動以）活動一下筋骨

notes.title: at the end of
notes.content: 在……末尾／結束時。例：There is a short quiz at the end of each unit.

notes.title: most 的冠詞規則
notes.content: most 表「大多數」時通常不加 the；最高級 most 修飾名詞時要加 the。例：Most students chose the most practical plan.

notes.title: make it to + 地方／活動
notes.content: 表示「成功抵達或趕上……」。例：We made it to the station just before the train left.

notes.title: see a doctor/client
notes.content: 看醫生／拜訪客戶。例：Henry saw the doctor this morning.（亨利今早去看醫生。）

notes.title: all the best
notes.content: （用於告別或信末祝福語）祝一切順利。

notes.title: hold on
notes.content: 稍等；也可指抓牢。例：Hold on a moment while I check the schedule.

notes.title: It is natural (for sb) to V
of one’s own 與 on one’s own
notes.content: of one’s own 是某人自己的；on one’s own 是獨自或靠自己。例：She wants a room of her own and can clean it on her own.

notes.title: have time / take one’s time
notes.content: have time 是有時間；take one’s time 是慢慢來、不必急。例：Take your time; we still have an hour.

notes.title: 數字-year-old + 名詞
notes.content: 作複合形容詞時 year 使用單數並加連字號。例：They have a six-year-old daughter.

notes.title: to some degree = to a (certain) degree
have good / bad / similar taste in...
sth cost sb + 金額
notes.content: 某物花某人若干金額。例：That car cost me a fortune.（買那輛車花了我不少錢。）

notes.title: be open to + N
notes.content: 表示「對……開放」，也可表示「願意接受……」。例：Our teacher is open to new ideas from the class.

notes.title: begin to V / begin V-ing
notes.content: 兩者多數情況都表示開始做某事。例：She began to laugh. = She began laughing.

notes.title: break the law / rule
notes.content: 違法／規。例：Christina would never break the school rules.（克莉絲蒂娜絕不會違反校規。）

notes.title: come close to + N / V-ing
notes.content: 表示「差一點……；幾乎達成……」。例：The team came close to winning the final game.

notes.title: by the sea 與 by sea
notes.content: by the sea 表示「在海邊」；by sea 表示「經由海路」。例：They live by the sea but usually travel by air.

notes.title: recover from... = get over... = recuperate from...
grow + adj.
notes.content: 變得……。例：As time went by, Clara grew older and wiser.（隨著歲月流逝，克萊拉變老也更有智慧。）

notes.title: take a break / rest
notes.content: 休息一下。例：Let's take a break for ten minutes before we go back to work again.（我們休息 10 分鐘再繼續工作。）

notes.title: be + 形容詞 + enough to V
notes.content: 表示「足夠……而能做……」。例：Nina is tall enough to reach the top shelf.

notes.title: cost sb sth
notes.content: 使某人失去某物。例：The reporter's racist comments cost him his job.（這位記者種族歧視的言論讓他丟了工作。）

notes.title: as + adj./adv. + as possible
notes.content: 儘可能地……。例：Come here as soon as possible.（儘快過來。）

notes.title: be close to + 地方／人
notes.content: 表示「距離近」或「與某人親近」。例：Our apartment is close to the train station.

notes.title: look back to + 特定時間／事件
notes.content: 表示「回想某個明確時間點或事件」。例：He looked back to the day he first visited the island.

notes.title: turn A into B = change A into B
each 用法
notes.content: each 作形容詞時置單數可數名詞前，後接動詞用單數；each 作代詞與 of 並用時連接複數名詞，後接動詞亦用單數。

notes.title: pattern oneself after sb
notes.content: 仿效某人，以某人為榜樣

notes.title: by now
notes.content: 表示「到目前為止、事到如今」，常搭配完成式或 should。例：The package should have arrived by now.

notes.title: as soon as...
notes.content: 一……就……。例：The boy cried as soon as he saw the stranger.（小男孩一看到那個陌生人就哭了。）

notes.title: have the right to V/N
notes.content: 有……的權利。例：In certain countries, women don't have the right to vote.（在某些國家，女性沒有投票權。）

notes.title: while 表時間與對比
notes.content: while 可表示「當……時」或「然而」，需靠兩子句關係判斷。例：While I prefer tea, my brother drinks coffee.

notes.title: a news / main / cover story
notes.content: 分別表示「新聞報導／主要報導／封面故事」。例：The discovery became the newspaper's main story.

notes.title: try + V-ing
notes.content: 嘗試……。例：I tried shutting the computer, but it didn't work.（我試過將電腦關機，但沒有效。）

notes.title: regular 與 regularly
notes.content: regular 是形容詞，修飾名詞；regularly 是副詞，修飾動詞。例：Regular exercise helps people sleep better, so Mia exercises regularly.

notes.title: for a while / once in a while
notes.content: for a while 是一段時間；once in a while 是偶爾。例：Sit here for a while; I visit this park once in a while.

notes.title: for one thing…, for another…
notes.content: 用來依序提出兩個理由：一方面……，另一方面……。例：I chose the train; for one thing, it is safer, and for another, it is cheaper.

notes.title: take place
notes.content: 發生、舉行；通常不用被動語態。例：The school festival will take place next Friday.

notes.title: have problems / difficulty V-ing
notes.content: 做某事有困難，也可說 have a hard time V-ing。例：He has difficulty remembering names.

notes.title: all alone / not … at all
notes.content: all alone 是獨自一人；not…at all 是一點也不。例：She wasn’t nervous at all, even though she performed all alone.

notes.title: provide against sth
notes.content: 防備、預防某事物；為（防備）某事物做準備

notes.title: find out
notes.content: 查明、弄清楚資訊。例：We need to find out when the last train leaves.

notes.title: run into + 人
notes.content: 表示「偶然遇見某人」。例：I ran into my former teacher at the night market.

notes.title: a drop in the ocean
notes.content: a drop in the ocean = a drop in the bucket：滄海一粟（英／美）。

notes.title: on sb's / the right side
notes.content: 在右邊。例：The Opera House is on your right side.（歌劇院在你的右邊。）

notes.title: be of (great) use
notes.content: 很有用，語意相當於 be (very) useful。例：The checklist was of great use during the trip.

notes.title: get along with + 人
notes.content: 表示「與某人相處融洽」。例：Tina gets along well with her new classmates.

notes.title: show up
notes.content: 出現、到場。例：Only eight players showed up for practice.

notes.title: carry a risk／a risk of V-ing
notes.content: 帶有風險；有做某事的風險。例：Driving while tired carries a serious risk.

notes.title: rack one's brains = beat one's brains
spark sb’s imagination
notes.content: spark sb’s imagination：激發某人的想像力。

notes.title: call sb (up) / call (up) sb = give sb a call
a sense of hearing / smell / taste
give in to
notes.content: 向壓力、誘惑或某人屈服。例：Don’t give in to fear before the contest begins.

notes.title: lose one's head
notes.content: 表示「慌張、失去冷靜」。例：Ben lost his head when the alarm suddenly rang.

notes.title: give to charity
notes.content: 捐款或捐物給慈善機構。例：We gave our unused coats to charity.

notes.title: in public
notes.content: 公開地，當眾。例：The basketball star hasn't been seen in public for years.（這名籃球明星好幾年沒公開出現了。）

notes.title: play the + 樂器名稱
notes.content: 彈奏某樂器。例：My sister plays the guitar very well.（我姊姊很會彈吉他。）

notes.title: work out sth / work sth out
notes.content: 想出、解決某事。例：Let’s work out a fair schedule together.

notes.title: 地方 + be peopled by / with...
notes.content: ……居住於某地。例：The town is peopled by students from the nearby university.（附近大學的學生居住在這個城鎮。）

notes.title: can：助動詞與一般動詞／名詞
notes.content: 助動詞 can 表能力或許可，後接原形動詞；一般動詞可指把食物裝罐，名詞指罐頭／罐子。例：She can swim, and she cans tomatoes every summer.

notes.title: make history
notes.content: 創造歷史。例：Neil Armstrong made history by walking on the moon.（尼爾·阿姆斯壯在月球上漫步創造了歷史。）

notes.title: house 作動詞
notes.content: 提供住處、收容。例：The shelter can house thirty people overnight.

notes.title: as + 身分／角色
notes.content: 作介系詞，表示「以……的身分；作為……」。例：As the team leader, Ben must make the final decision.

notes.title: sense + N／sense + that 子句
notes.content: 感覺或察覺某事。例：I sensed that something had changed.

notes.title: percentage 搭配
notes.content: a large percentage of …：相當大百分比的…／大部分…；a small percentage of …：很小百分比的…／一小部分…。

notes.title: because of + N/V-ing = due to + N/V-ing = as a result of + N/V-ing = thanks to + N/V-ing
break a record
notes.content: 打破紀錄。例：He just broke the Olympic record for the men's 100-meter dash.（他剛剛打破了男子 100 公尺短跑奧運紀錄。）

notes.title: for ages
notes.content: 很久。＝ for a long time。例：I haven't seen Sam for ages.（我好久都沒見到山姆了。）

notes.title: would like to V / feel like V-ing
notes.content: would like to V 是想要做；feel like V-ing 是有做某事的心情。例：I’d like to rest, but I don’t feel like sleeping.

notes.title: close with + N
notes.content: 表示「以……作結」。例：The ceremony closed with a performance by the school band.

notes.title: behind sb’s back
notes.content: 在某人背後、瞞著某人。例：It is unfair to make decisions behind her back.

notes.title: located 後介詞的選用
notes.content: in 與大城市或區域並用；on 與街道或山峰並用；at 與轉角或某個有地址號碼的房舍並用。

notes.title: be made of...
notes.content: 由……製成（用於可辨認原材料時）。

notes.title: The following are + 複數可數名詞
go + 形容詞
notes.content: 表示「變成某種狀態」，常用於不良或明顯變化。例：The bread went stale after being left outside.

notes.title: give and take
notes.content: 互相讓步、彼此妥協。例：Good teamwork requires patience and give and take.

notes.title: get home / get to + 地方
notes.content: get home 不加 to；其他多數地點使用 get to。例：We got to the hotel after midnight and got home the next afternoon.

notes.title: It remains to be seen + 疑問詞子句
notes.content: It remains to be seen 之後接 when、what、how 等疑問詞引導的名詞子句，表「……有待觀察」。

notes.title: make a fire
notes.content: 生火。例：Let's make a fire to keep us warm.（我們生火來保暖吧！）

notes.title: be about to V
notes.content: 正要、即將做某事，通常指很快就會發生。例：The show is about to begin, so please take your seat.

notes.title: transfer sb to
notes.content: transfer sb to + 地方：調至某地。

notes.title: stand in one’s way
notes.content: 妨礙、阻擋某人。例：Don’t let one mistake stand in your way.

notes.title: choke
notes.content: choke sb to death；choke to death；choke on sth。

notes.title: end up + V-ing
notes.content: 最後結果竟然做了某事。例：We missed the bus and ended up walking home.

notes.title: come across + 人／事物
notes.content: 表示「偶然遇見、無意間發現」。例：I came across an old photograph while cleaning the attic.

notes.title: also 與 too 的位置
notes.content: also 通常放在一般動詞前、be 動詞後；too 通常放在句尾。例：Nora is a doctor and is also a writer.／Nora is a writer, too.

notes.title: start a family
notes.content: 通常表示夫妻「開始生育、組成有孩子的家庭」。例：The couple hopes to start a family in a few years.

notes.title: recover + 失物／recover from + 狀況
notes.content: recover 接物品表示尋回；recover from 表示從疾病、打擊或困境中恢復。例：The police recovered the stolen bike, and its owner soon recovered from the shock.

notes.title: sb demand / require / request that S (+ should) + V
The following is + 單數可數名詞
It’s sb’s turn to V
notes.content: 輪到某人做某事。例：It’s your turn to choose the next song.

notes.title: due / owing to + N/V-ing ＝ because of... ＝ on account of... ＝ as a result of...
follow one's heart
notes.content: 隨心所欲。例：You should follow your heart and ask her out.（你應該跟隨自己的內心，邀她出去。）

notes.title: one another = each other
notes.content: 互相、彼此。例：The teammates encouraged one another before the game.

notes.title: stretch out one's hand / foot to V
to make a long story short
notes.content: 表示「長話短說」。例：To make a long story short, we missed the final train.

notes.title: use one's brain
notes.content: 用某人的腦子；動動某人的腦子

notes.title: one’s take on sth
notes.content: 某人對某事的看法。例：What is your take on the new school rule?

notes.title: for an instant
notes.content: 那一瞬間，有那麼一會兒。

notes.title: encourage + 人 + to V
notes.content: 鼓勵某人做某事。例：Our coach encouraged us to try again.

notes.title: open at + 時間 / open a meeting with + N
notes.content: open 可表示「開始營業」，也可表示「開始會議或活動」。例：The chairperson opened the meeting with a short announcement.

notes.title: just 的常見副詞義
notes.content: 可表示剛剛、正好、只是或加強語氣，需依語境判斷。例：I just arrived. / This key is just what we need.

notes.title: for 與 because
notes.content: 皆可表「因為」；for 可作對等連接詞，連接兩個對等子句且不置句首；because 為從屬連接詞，引導的子句可置句首或主要子句後。

notes.title: be in need of sth
notes.content: 需要某物。例：Sally's hair is in need of a cut.（莎莉的頭髮需要剪一下了。）

notes.title: allow sb/sth to V
notes.content: 允許某人／某事物……。例：My parents wouldn't allow me to go out alone.（我爸媽不允許我一個人出門。）

notes.title: because of + N / V-ing
notes.content: because of 後接名詞、代名詞或 V-ing；because 後接完整子句。例：The game was delayed because of heavy rain.

notes.title: in order of importance / difficulty
notes.content: 按重要性／難度的順序。例：We learned those words in order of importance.（我們是依重要性的順序來學那些字。）

notes.title: from now on
notes.content: 表示「從現在起」。例：From now on, I'll check my work more carefully.

notes.title: all day / night long
notes.content: 表示「整天／整夜一直……」。例：The neighbors' dog barked all night long.

notes.title: reflect on + N
notes.content: 表示「認真回想、反思……」。例：At the end of the course, students reflected on what they had learned.

notes.title: make a decision ＝ make up one's mind
possess 句型
notes.content: be possessed of sth＝possess sth：擁有（能力、技能等）；be possessed by a ghost：被鬼魂附身。

notes.title: can't get enough of + N
notes.content: 表示「非常喜愛……，怎麼都不嫌多」。例：My brother can't get enough of mystery stories.

notes.title: once 表示「曾經」
notes.content: 表示過去某段時間曾有的狀態。例：This quiet street was once a busy market.

notes.title: be + 數字 + years old
notes.content: 表示年齡。例：The museum is more than one hundred years old.

notes.title: be known to + 人
notes.content: 為某人或某群體所知。例：The story is known to children throughout the country.

notes.title: since 表『自從』的時態要求
notes.content: since 表『自從』時，可作連接詞，其所引導的副詞子句須使用過去式；作介詞時，其所引導的介詞片語則須為過去的時間點，而主要子句的時態應採『現在完成式』或『現在完成進行式』。例：We haven't seen each other since last year.（我們從去年起就沒見過面了。）

notes.title: call sth off / call off sth
enough 的位置
notes.content: 修飾名詞時放前面：enough time；修飾形容詞或副詞時放後面：old enough、quickly enough。例：The room is large enough for twenty people.

notes.title: send sb sth = send sth to sb
back and forth
notes.content: 來回地。例：The dog ran back and forth across the yard.

notes.title: against one’s will
notes.content: 違背某人的意願。例：No one should be forced to join against their will.

notes.title: see sb
notes.content: 和某人交往。例：Katie has been seeing her boyfriend for two years.（凱蒂和她男朋友交往 2 年了。）

notes.title: start to V / start V-ing
notes.content: 兩者多數情況都表示開始做某事。例：It started to rain. = It started raining.

notes.title: no later than + 時間
notes.content: 在某個時間點之前。例：The article must be submitted no later than May 31st.（這篇文章得在 5 月 31 日前遞交。）

notes.title: solve / face a problem
notes.content: 解決／面對問題。例：We must face the problem before we can solve it.

notes.title: a glass of water
notes.content: 一杯水。例：Just give me a glass of water.（給我一杯水就可以了。）

notes.title: go back (to + 地方) / go back home
notes.content: 回某地用 go back to；home 前不加 to。例：I went back to the store, then went back home.

notes.title: only 的三種角色
notes.content: 作副詞表示「僅僅」，作形容詞表示「唯一的」，作連接詞可表示「可是、只不過」。例：I wanted to join them, only I had to work.

notes.title: however 表「無論如何」
notes.content: however 表「無論如何」時，等於 no matter how，之後先接形容詞或副詞，再接主詞及動詞。

notes.title: perform a mission
notes.content: 執行任務。同義說法：carry out a mission。

notes.title: go on a trip / tour
notes.content: 表示「去旅行／參加遊覽」。例：Our class went on a science tour during the winter break.

notes.title: place importance on sth
notes.content: 重視某事。例：This school places great importance on independent reading.

notes.title: like V-ing / like to V
notes.content: 兩者都可表示喜歡；V-ing 常偏一般喜好，to V 可偏某次選擇或習慣。例：I like reading, but tonight I’d like to watch a film.

notes.title: stay + adj.
notes.content: 保持……。例：Where did you stay while you were in Paris?（此句實為 stay at/in，非 stay+adj，書頁該條例句另見 p.95）

notes.title: at the age of + 數字
notes.content: 在若干歲時。例：Steven left home at the age of 25.（史蒂芬在 25 歲時離家。）

notes.title: put A through to B
notes.content: 把 A 的電話轉接給 B。

notes.title: give sb sth = give sth to sb
first thing (in the morning)
notes.content: 一早第一件事；表示某事會優先處理。例：I’ll call the clinic first thing in the morning.

notes.title: be known as + 身分／名稱
notes.content: 以某個名稱或身分為人所知。例：The town is known as the flower capital of the region.

notes.title: hold a meeting
notes.content: 舉行會議。例：The club will hold a meeting after lunch.

notes.title: mean to V
notes.content: 有意要做……。＝ intend to V。

notes.title: on one’s way to
notes.content: 在前往某地的途中。例：I bought some fruit on my way home.

notes.title: sb's public image
notes.content: 某人的公眾形象。例：The actor's public image has been ruined by the incident.（這名演員的公眾形象被這起事件毀了。）

notes.title: be associated with...
notes.content: 與……有關；= be connected to / with...。

notes.title: A is different from B (in...)
notes.content: A 與 B（在……方面）不同。＝ A differs from B in...。例：Gina is very different from her sister in personality.（吉娜與她妹妹在個性方面很不同。）

notes.title: refer to the dictionary / phone book
notes.content: 查字典／電話簿；= consult the dictionary / phone book。

notes.title: though 作副詞
notes.content: though 作副詞表「然而」，等於 however，通常置於句尾。

notes.title: stay out
notes.content: 表示「待在外面、不回家」，常與時間搭配。例：You shouldn't stay out too late on a school night.

notes.title: resolve 句型
notes.content: resolve / solve the problem；resolve to + V；strengthen / weaken sb’s resolve。

notes.title: name A + 名字 + after B
notes.content: 依 B 之名將 A 取名為……。例：We named him Henry after his grandfather.（我們以他祖父之名將他命名為亨利。）

notes.title: set off fireworks
notes.content: ：鞭炮（可數）。set off a firecracker；firework(s)、set off fireworks。

notes.title: turn around / turn right / left
notes.content: 轉身；右轉／左轉。例：Turn left at the light, then turn around at the gate.

notes.title: be due to V ＝ be expected to V
a ten-story building
notes.content: story 也可表示建築物的「樓層」；作複合形容詞時使用單數。例：They work in a twelve-story building.

notes.title: as a matter of fact = in fact
about 表大約
notes.content: about + 數量／時間表示約莫。例：The walk takes about fifteen minutes.

notes.title: be fast approaching ＝ be around the corner ＝ be near at hand ＝ be coming soon
belief about + N
notes.content: 表示「對某件事的信念或看法」。例：Their beliefs about education are quite different.

notes.title: most 的冠詞
notes.content: 作形容詞表「最多的」時前加 the；表「大多數的」時不加 the。作最高級副詞表「最」修飾副詞、動詞時不一定加 the；修飾名詞時須加 the。

notes.title: add A to B
notes.content: 將 A 加進 B。例：If you add two and three, you get five.（2 加 3 等於 5。）

notes.title: out of sb's reach
notes.content: 某人碰不到。例：Knives and forks should be put out of children's reach.（刀叉應該放在孩童伸手拿不到的地方。）

notes.title: Not until 句首倒裝
notes.content: not until 引導的否定副詞子句置句首時，其後須採倒裝句構。

notes.title: a relationship between A and B
notes.content: A 和 B 之間的關係

notes.title: look back on + 一段時期／經歷
notes.content: 表示「回顧某段經歷」。例：She looks back on her school days with gratitude.

notes.title: make + 受詞 + 形容詞／名詞
notes.content: 表示「使……變得……」或「使……成為……」。例：The good news made her happy.

notes.title: still 的位置
notes.content: 表「仍然」時，通常置於一般動詞前、be 動詞後。例：He still studies there. / He is still a student.

notes.title: have little/a lot/nothing in common (with sb)
notes.content: （與某人）有很少／許多／沒有共同點。例：Even though we are twins, we have very little in common with each other.（雖然我們是雙胞胎，彼此的共同點卻很少。）

notes.title: be true to sb ＝ be faithful to sb
big brother / sister
notes.content: 口語中常表示「哥哥／姊姊」，但正式表達年齡關係通常用 older brother／sister。例：My older sister studies in Kaohsiung.

notes.title: a real find
notes.content: 名詞用法，指難得發現的好東西或好人選。例：This quiet café is a real find.

notes.title: pursue 搭配
notes.content: pursue one’s goals；pursue one’s dreams；pursue a girl＝chase a girl＝chase after a girl。

notes.title: a story about / of + N
notes.content: 表示「關於……的故事」。例：Grandma told us a story about her childhood.

notes.title: food 與 foods
notes.content: 泛指食物時通常不可數；指不同種類的食物時可用複數 foods。例：The market sells foods from several countries.

notes.title: certain of... ＝ some of...
notes.content: 一些……。例：Certain of the employees take long coffee breaks.（有些員工喝咖啡的休息時間很久。）

notes.title: How come + S + V?
notes.content: 口語「為什麼……？」後面用直述句語序，不倒裝。例：How come you are home so early?

notes.title: spare
notes.content: spare no effort to + V；spare sb's feelings；a spare tire；Spare the rod, spoil the child.

notes.title: get + adj.
notes.content: 表「變得」時為連綴動詞，後接形容詞。

notes.title: turn right
notes.content: 右轉。＝ turn to the right。例：Turn right at the next block, and you'll see the restaurant.（在下一個街區右轉，你就會看到那間餐廳了。）

notes.title: will 的時態與否定
notes.content: 助動詞用於未來式；過去式為 would；否定 will not 可縮寫為 won't。

notes.title: appeal to + 人 / have appeal for + 人
notes.content: 表示「對某人具有吸引力」。例：The simple design appeals to customers of all ages.

notes.title: identify A as B
notes.content: 將 A 認定為 B。

notes.title: be made from...
notes.content: 由……製成（用於無法辨認原材料時）。

notes.title: wait a minute = hold on a minute
fall down
notes.content: 跌倒。例：The old woman fell down and hurt her leg.（老婆婆跌倒，傷了腿。）

notes.title: be new to + 人
notes.content: 表示某件事「對某人而言很陌生、不熟悉」。例：The software is still new to our team.

notes.title: work for
notes.content: 替某人或機構工作。例：My aunt works for a local newspaper.

notes.title: many happy returns (of the day)
notes.content: 祝（你）長命百歲／祝（你）生日快樂。

notes.title: balance A on B
notes.content: 把 A 平衡在 B 上。

notes.title: become + adj. / noun
notes.content: 表示變得……或成為……。例：The sky became dark, and Mia became the team leader.

notes.title: for better or (for) worse
notes.content: 不論好壞，不管結果如何

notes.title: a man / woman of few words
intimate
notes.content: an intimate friend = a very close friend。

notes.title: be through with ...
notes.content: be through with ... = be finished with ... = be done with ... = finish ...；做完……。

notes.title: on time 與 in time
notes.content: on time 是準時；in time 是及時、趕在太晚之前。例：The bus arrived on time, and we reached the gate in time for boarding.

notes.title: route 句型
notes.content: sth be routed via / through + 地方：某物透過某地運送。

notes.title: convince sb to + V
notes.content: 說服某人做……；= persuade sb to + V。

notes.title: be out of order
notes.content: （機器）故障。例：The telephone is out of order again!（這電話又壞了。）

notes.title: It is said that + 子句
notes.content: 被動句型，表示「據說……」。例：It is said that the castle is over five hundred years old.

notes.title: would like to V = feel like + V-ing
be good at + N / V-ing
notes.content: 表示「擅長……」；接動作時使用 V-ing。例：My sister is good at solving logic puzzles.

notes.title: look for work = look for a job
go for a run
notes.content: 去跑步。例：I'm going for a run after work.（我下班後要去跑步。）

notes.title: call sth off
notes.content: 取消某事。例：They called off the picnic because of the storm.

notes.title: lay / put / place stress on...
notes.content: 強調……（＝ lay / put / place emphasis on...）。

notes.title: 數字-year-old
notes.content: 可表「若干歲的」，此為形容詞，須置名詞前，year 不加 s，如 a two-year-old girl。

notes.title: a call for help
notes.content: 求救聲或求援。例：We heard a call for help from the riverbank.

notes.title: Trick or treat.
notes.content: 不給糖就搗蛋。（萬聖夜兒童用語）

notes.title: in that case / just in case
notes.content: in that case 是既然如此；just in case 是以防萬一。例：It may rain; in that case, take this umbrella just in case.

notes.title: at most
notes.content: 至多、不超過。例：The repair will take two hours at most.

notes.title: time sth to V
notes.content: 安排某事在適當時間發生，以便達成目的。例：We timed our arrival to avoid the afternoon traffic.

notes.title: get used to + N/V-ing ＝ get accustomed to + N/V-ing
one...the other...
notes.content: 談論確定的兩個人或事物時，表示「一個……，另一個……」。例：I bought two notebooks; one is blue, and the other is green.

notes.title: between A and B / in between
notes.content: between A and B 表兩者之間；in between 可單獨表示在中間。例：The pharmacy is between the bank and the café.

notes.title: identify with...
notes.content: 對……感同身受；對……產生認同感。

notes.title: bring sb sth = bring sth to sb
expose A to B
notes.content: expose A to B：使 A 暴露於 B；使 A 接觸 B。

notes.title: leave sb/sth + adj.
notes.content: 使某人或某物處於某狀態。例：Please leave the window open for a while.

notes.title: small 的延伸義
notes.content: 除了尺寸小，也可表示「年幼的、不重要的、輕微的」。例：One small error changed the final result.

notes.title: light sth up / light up sth
tell / read + 人 + a story
notes.content: 表示「講／念故事給某人聽」。例：Dad reads the children a story every night.

notes.title: an only child
notes.content: 獨生子／女。例：Vincent loves being an only child.（文森喜歡當獨生子。）

notes.title: transform
notes.content: transform A into B = convert / change / turn A into B。

notes.title: just 作形容詞
notes.content: 表示公平、公正。例：Everyone deserves a just decision.

notes.title: It is rare (for sb/sth) to V
and the like
notes.content: 等等、諸如此類。例：The shop sells notebooks, pens, stickers, and the like.

notes.title: a parking lot
notes.content: 停車場。例：They asked the government to build more parking lots for local people.（他們要求政府為當地居民多建一些停車場。）

notes.title: be liberal (with sth)
notes.content: （在某事物方面）很肆意；有大量的（某事物）。

notes.title: in a way / in some ways
notes.content: in a way 是在某方面；in some ways 是在若干方面。例：In some ways, online classes are more flexible.

notes.title: right now
notes.content: 可表示「現在、此刻」，也可表示「馬上、立刻」。例：I need to speak with you right now.

notes.title: be possible (for sb) to V
notes.content: （某人）做……是可能的。例：It's possible to order a copy of the book online.（從網路上訂一本這本書是可行的。）

notes.title: high 與 tall
notes.content: high 常形容建築、位置或程度；tall 常形容人、樹木及直立物體的高度。例：The tower is very high, and the trees beside it are tall.

notes.title: group … by …
notes.content: 依某標準將事物分組。例：The teacher grouped the words by topic.

notes.title: know for certain / sure
notes.content: 確知。例：Nobody knows for certain when Michael is coming back.（沒有人確知邁可什麼時候會回來。）

notes.title: try to V
notes.content: 設法／試圖做……。例：I know you're busy, but try to come.（我知道你很忙，但試著來看看。）

notes.title: every now and then
notes.content: 偶爾、間或。例：I enjoy a sweet drink every now and then.

notes.title: run out of sth
notes.content: 用盡某物。例：Our car was running out of gas.（我們的車子快沒汽油了。）

notes.title: believe (that)...
notes.content: 相信／認為……。例：Do you believe that he is telling the truth?（你相信他在說實話嗎？）

notes.title: at will
notes.content: 隨意地、任意地。例：Members may enter the reading room at will.

notes.title: call sb (up) / give sb a call
notes.content: 打電話給某人。例：Give me a call when you reach the station.

notes.title: look for work / look for a job
notes.content: 找工作。例：He moved to the city to look for work.

notes.title: place an order (for sth)
notes.content: 下訂單。例：Dad placed an order for two sandwiches online.

notes.title: a shopping center
notes.content: 購物中心。例：The shopping center is going to open next month.（這個購物中心將於下個月開幕。）

notes.title: keep + adj. / keep (on) V-ing
notes.content: keep + adj. 表保持狀態；keep (on) V-ing 表繼續做。例：Keep calm and keep trying.

notes.title: counter
notes.content: over the counter；counter with ...；run counter to ...。

notes.title: get off to a good / poor start
notes.content: 有好／不順利的開端。例：The team got off to a good start with an early goal.

notes.title: get + 人／事物 + 形容詞
notes.content: 表示「使某人或某物進入某種狀態」。例：The long delay got everyone worried.

notes.title: as + adj./adv. + as + N
notes.content: 和……一樣……（第一個 as 為副詞，第二個 as 為連接詞）。例：You are as smart as a genius.（你像天才一樣聰明。）

notes.title: once 表示「一次」
notes.content: 表示次數。例：I have visited that museum only once.

notes.title: dwell in ... = reside in ...
notes.content: *vi.* 居住；dwell–dwelt/dwelled–dwelt/dwelled：dwell in ... = reside in ...、dwell on ...；dwelling 住所。

notes.title: be in the process of + N/V-ing
S + V, only to + V
notes.content: 表示後來發生出乎意料、往往令人失望的結果，不表示目的。例：We hurried to the station, only to discover that the train had left.

notes.title: take / catch hold of
notes.content: 抓住。例：She took hold of the railing before stepping down.

notes.title: take part in
notes.content: 參加，相當於 participate in。例：More than fifty students took part in the contest.

notes.title: once and for all
notes.content: 斷然地，最後一次地。例：John has quit smoking once and for all.（約翰徹底戒菸了。）

notes.title: while away + 時間
notes.content: 消磨時間。例：We whiled away the rainy afternoon with board games.

notes.title: go well / badly
notes.content: 表示事情「進行順利／不順利」。例：The presentation went better than we expected.

notes.title: head for / toward + 地方
notes.content: 此處 head 作動詞，表示「朝……前進」。例：Dark clouds appeared, so we headed for home.

notes.title: change hands
notes.content: 易手、轉由另一位擁有者持有。例：The old house has changed hands several times.

notes.title: a forest fire
notes.content: 森林火災。例：A forest fire broke out last night.（昨晚發生了一場森林火災。）

notes.title: by the name of...
notes.content: 名叫……。例：I met a guy by the name of John Smith.（我遇到一位名叫約翰·史密斯的人。）

notes.title: Under no circumstances + 倒裝句
notes.content: 絕不……；= By no means / In no way / On no account + 倒裝句。

notes.title: color 作動詞
notes.content: color 可表示「替……上色／染色」，也可表示某物變色。例：The children colored the map blue and green.

notes.title: promise to V = make a promise to V
use A as B
notes.content: 把 A 當作 B 使用。例：They use the spare room as a study.

notes.title: across from...
notes.content: 在……對面。例：I live in a building across from the post office.（我住在郵局對面的一棟大樓裡。）

notes.title: mean a lot / nothing to sb
notes.content: 對某人意義重大／毫無意義。

notes.title: be on the market
notes.content: 上市。例：This new product will soon be on the market.（這個新產品很快就會上市。）

notes.title: in case of + N
notes.content: 萬一……。＝ in the event of + N。例：In case of emergency, call this number.（萬一有緊急事件，請打這個號碼。）

notes.title: watch out
notes.content: 留神，注意。例：Watch out! That car almost hit you.（小心！那輛車差點撞到你。）

notes.title: for some reason / for no reason
notes.content: 分別表示「不知何故／無緣無故」。例：For some reason, my phone won't connect to the network.

notes.title: think twice before + V-ing
notes.content: 做某事前再三考慮。例：Think twice before sharing personal information online.

notes.title: each and every
notes.content: 每一個的（用於加強語氣）。

notes.title: provide sb with sth ＝ provide sth for sb
lead an active life
notes.content: 過著很忙碌活躍的生活。

notes.title: yet 作副詞的句型限制
notes.content: yet 作副詞，表『還，尚未』時，須用於否定句或疑問句。例：Chris hasn't shown up yet.（克里斯還未現身。）

notes.title: come to V
notes.content: 表示「過來做某事」，to 後接原形動詞。例：Nora came to help us prepare the room.

notes.title: polish
notes.content: polish (up) ... = improve ...；polish off ...；give sth a polish；nail polish。

notes.title: enjoy 的受詞形式
notes.content: enjoy 之後接名詞或動名詞作受詞。

notes.title: for the time being
notes.content: 暫時、目前先如此。例：The library is closed, so we’ll study at home for the time being.

notes.title: be known for + 特點／事物
notes.content: 因某項特色而聞名。例：The restaurant is known for its fresh seafood.

notes.title: offer sb sth ＝ offer sth to sb
smooth out...
notes.content: 把（衣服或紙張等的皺摺）用平。

notes.title: It is likely that... ＝ S + be likely to V
appoint 句型
notes.content: appoint sb to + V＝assign sb to + V：指定某人做事；appoint sb as + 職位＝assign sb (to be) + 職位：指定某人擔任…職位。

notes.title: would like to + V
notes.content: 禮貌表達「想要做……」，後面接原形動詞。例：We would like to reserve a table for four.

notes.title: still 表「還」的位置
notes.content: 僅用於肯定句；一般動詞時置一般動詞前，be 動詞時置 be 動詞後。

notes.title: fire a shot at sth
notes.content: 朝……開槍。例：The hunter fired a shot at a tiger.（獵人朝著老虎開了一槍。）

notes.title: found + 組織／公司／機構
notes.content: 此處是「創立、建立」，過去式和過去分詞都是 founded；不要和 find 的過去式 found 混淆。例：The sisters founded a small design studio together.

notes.title: be located in / on / at...
notes.content: 位於……。同義句型：be situated in / on / at...；lie in / on / at...。

notes.title: code 搭配
notes.content: break a code：破解密碼；a dress code：服裝規定。

notes.title: take + 事物 + to heart
notes.content: 表示「認真接受忠告」或「因別人的話而介意」。例：Mia took her coach's advice to heart and practiced harder.

notes.title: on the border of A and B
notes.content: 在 A 和 B 的交界處

notes.title: on account of... = because of... = due to... = owing to...
well 的詞性
notes.content: 副詞表示做得好；形容詞表示身體健康；名詞可指井。例：She sings well but doesn’t feel well today.

notes.title: keep one's head
notes.content: 表示「保持冷靜」。例：Try to keep your head if something goes wrong.

notes.title: replace A with B
notes.content: 以 B 取代 A，把 A 換成 B。

notes.title: interpret A as B
notes.content: interpret A as B：將 A 詮釋為 B。

notes.title: run into...（撞上人／物）
notes.content: 撞上……。書頁「run into... 與……不期而遇；撞上……」的後半義。既有列 126 只涵蓋「偶遇」義

notes.title: have a … feel to it
notes.content: 帶有某種感覺或氛圍。例：The small café has a warm, old-fashioned feel to it.

notes.title: reach a new high
notes.content: 表示數量、價格或程度「創新高」。例：Ticket sales reached a new high this month.

notes.title: feel like + V-ing = would like to V = want to V
earn one’s keep
notes.content: 賺取生活費、靠工作養活自己。例：He worked weekends to earn his keep.

notes.title: by no means = not...by any means
take back + N / take + N + back
notes.content: 表示「拿回、送回」。受詞是代名詞時放中間：take it back。例：She took the damaged lamp back to the shop.

notes.title: play a part / role in
notes.content: 在……中扮演角色、發揮作用。例：Sleep plays an important part in learning.

notes.title: be used to + N/V-ing ＝ be accustomed to + N/V-ing
It is important (for sb) to V
be consequent on...
notes.content: 因……而起的；= be caused by...。

notes.title: sooner or later
notes.content: 遲早（＝ eventually）。例：If you don't listen, you'll be sorry sooner or later.（你要是不聽的話，遲早會後悔的。）

notes.title: center on...
notes.content: 集中於……。＝ focus on...。例：Much of the debate centered on privacy issues.（大部分的辯論都集中於隱私權議題。）

notes.title: identify A with B
notes.content: 將 A 與 B 視為相等。

notes.title: when 子句的被動簡化
notes.content: 副詞子句為被動語態時，可省略重複主詞及 be 動詞，保留過去分詞。例：When asked about the mistake, he apologized immediately.

notes.title: take / do the minutes
notes.content: 表示「做會議紀錄」。例：Karen volunteered to take the minutes at today's meeting.

notes.title: think that / think about / think of
notes.content: think that 後接看法；think about 表仔細考慮；think of 可指想到或對……有何看法。例：Think about the choices before you decide.

notes.title: stand in the / one's way
notes.content: 擋住某人去路；阻礙某人。

notes.title: as + 子句：當……時
notes.content: 作連接詞，表示兩件事同時發生。例：As the sun went down, the air became cooler.

notes.title: defend sb/sth against...
notes.content: 保護某人／某事物免受……；為……替某人／某事物做辯護。

notes.title: then 作形容詞
notes.content: 放在名詞前表示「當時的」。例：The then principal introduced the new library plan.

notes.title: a big day / decision
notes.content: big 可表示「重要、影響重大」，不只是尺寸大。例：Choosing a university is a big decision.

notes.title: cause sb to V = make sb + V
To make a long story short,...
in a second = in a moment
set off a firecracker
notes.content: ：鞭炮（可數）。set off a firecracker；firework(s)、set off fireworks。

notes.title: carry out...
notes.content: 執行……。書頁列為 perform 的類義說法，但為多詞片語，不作關聯詞端點。

notes.title: old / elderly / former / previous
notes.content: old 可指年老或使用已久；elderly 專指年長者；former 指以前的身分；previous 指時間或順序上的前一個。例：I met a former teacher at my previous workplace.

notes.title: in one's head
notes.content: 表示「在某人的腦中、心裡」。例：I kept repeating the address in my head.

notes.title: halt
notes.content: come to a halt = grind to a halt。

notes.title: come into being = come into existence
long to V / long for + N
notes.content: 表示「渴望做……／渴望得到……」。例：After months abroad, he longed to see his family again.

notes.title: at heart
notes.content: 內心。例：Jay is serious in appearance but kind at heart.（傑伊外表嚴肅，但內心很和善。）

notes.title: strike a balance between A and B
notes.content: 在 A 與 B 之間維持平衡。

notes.title: go + V-ing
notes.content: 常用於戶外、休閒或體育活動。例：We went cycling along the river last Sunday.

notes.title: food 的可數性
notes.content: 一般視為集合名詞、不可數；指特定一種或幾種食物時可數。

notes.title: recover from...
notes.content: 從……恢復過來／復元；= get over...；= recuperate from...。

notes.title: reach for sth
notes.content: 伸手拿某物。例：Ezra reached for his wallet.（以斯拉伸手拿皮夾。）

notes.title: try sth on / try on sth
notes.content: 試穿／戴（衣服、帽子等）。例：Can I try on these shoes?（我可以試穿一下這雙鞋子嗎？）

notes.title: reach + 地點
notes.content: 到達某地。＝ arrive at / in + 地點。

notes.title: cost 與 spend 的辨析
notes.content: cost 和 spend 的中文均可譯成『花費』，惟 cost 的主詞是事物，spend 的主詞則是人。

notes.title: nod / shake one's head
notes.content: 分別表示「點頭／搖頭」。例：Leo shook his head when I asked whether he agreed.

notes.title: instant noodles / coffee / soup
notes.content: 泡麵／即溶咖啡／即溶湯品。

notes.title: take note of...
notes.content: 留意……。例：You should take note of Ned's behavior.（你該注意奈德的言行。）

notes.title: on second thought = on second thoughts
can 的時態與否定
notes.content: 助動詞過去式為 could；否定為 cannot 或 can't。

notes.title: be high in... = be rich in...
go by
notes.content: 用於時間，表示「流逝、過去」。例：The afternoon went by quickly while we were talking.

notes.title: be occupied with + N/V-ing
notes.content: 忙於做……；= be busy with + N；= be busy + V-ing。

notes.title: bring sb sth / bring sth to sb
notes.content: 雙受詞句型；把某物帶給某人。例：Please bring me the form. = Please bring the form to me.

notes.title: keep up with
notes.content: 跟上進度或速度。例：I review every night to keep up with the class.

notes.title: privilege
notes.content: have the privilege of + V-ing = have the honor of + V-ing；be / feel privileged to + V。

notes.title: It is useless to V
notes.content: 做某事沒有用。例：It is useless to argue after the decision is final.

notes.title: draft
notes.content: draft a plan = draw up a plan = map out a plan。

notes.title: insurance
notes.content: life insurance；health insurance；insure (sb/sth) against ...；assure sb of ... = assure sb that ...。

notes.title: hard to say
notes.content: 表示「很難判斷、難以斷言」。例：It's hard to say which plan will cost less.

notes.title: wait / hold on a minute
notes.content: 表示「請稍等一下」。例：Hold on a minute while I find the document.

notes.title: at sb’s place
notes.content: 在某人家裡。例：We are meeting at Jason’s place after dinner.

notes.title: as + 子句：因為……
notes.content: 作連接詞，說明原因，語氣通常比 because 輕。例：As the road was blocked, we chose another route.

notes.title: as if...
notes.content: 好像／似乎……。例：The man looked as if he was going to faint.（那名男子看起來好像要暈倒了。）

notes.title: need 作助動詞
notes.content: need 作助動詞的用法，在英式英語中較常見，且多用於否定句構中，例：need not V 不必做…… ＝ needn't V。例：It's only a short test; you needn't worry.（這只是個簡短的考試，你不必擔心。）

notes.title: adjust to
notes.content: adjust to + N/V-ing＝adapt (oneself) to + N/V-ing＝accustom oneself to + N/V-ing：使自己適應…。

notes.title: reason that + 子句 / reason with + 人
notes.content: reason that 表示「推論……」；reason with 表示「與某人講道理」。例：We tried to reason with him, but he refused to listen.

notes.title: be worn out
notes.content: 累壞了（＝ be tired out ＝ be exhausted）。例：I was worn out after all the work.（所有工作做完後，我累壞了。）

notes.title: be made of 與 be made from
notes.content: be made of 用於仍看得出原料；be made from 用於原料經加工後難以辨認。例：The chair is made of wood, while paper is made from wood.

notes.title: 數量詞 + of + which
notes.content: 非限定關係子句中，先行詞為事物時可用 some／many／most／all／none + of which；不可改用 that。例：She borrowed five books, two of which were about space.

notes.title: roughly + 數字
notes.content: 表示大約、約莫，語氣較口語。例：The journey takes roughly two hours.

notes.title: play with...
notes.content: 和……一起玩。例：Little Vincent loves to play with his toy cars.（小文森喜歡玩他的玩具車。）

notes.title: call a meeting
notes.content: 召開會議。例：The coach called a meeting after practice.

notes.title: tell / read sb a story
notes.content: 告訴某人一個故事／念故事給某人聽。

notes.title: keep up with + N
notes.content: 表示「持續掌握、跟上……」。例：Dad reads the news every morning to keep up with world events.

notes.title: balance A against B
notes.content: 對 A 和 B 兩者作出權衡。

notes.title: It is important for + 人 + to V
notes.content: 表示「某人做……很重要」。例：It is important for children to get enough sleep.

notes.title: work 的延伸義
notes.content: 機器 work 表運作，方法 work 表有效；複數 works 可指作品。例：The printer works, and the artist’s latest works are upstairs.

notes.title: sth needs + V-ing
notes.content: 某物需要以……方法處理。＝ sth needs to be + p.p.。例：Your car needs washing. ＝ Your car needs to be washed.（你的車需要洗了。）

notes.title: make 的使役用法
notes.content: 使役時用 make + 受詞 + 原形動詞；表「使得／成為」時用 make + 受詞 + 形容詞／名詞（受詞補語）。

notes.title: come in first / second / third place
notes.content: 比賽獲得第一／二／三名。例：Our class came in second place in the relay.

notes.title: break into...
notes.content: 闖入……。例：The thief broke into my house and stole a gold watch.（小偷闖入我家偷走了一只金錶。）

notes.title: take a taxi / train / bus
notes.content: 搭乘交通工具；冠詞依交通工具而定。例：We took a train to Hualien.

notes.title: be eager to + 原形動詞
notes.content: 渴望、迫切想做某事。例：The children were eager to see the new animals.

notes.title: It takes sb + 時間 + to V
notes.content: 表示某人花多少時間做某事。例：It takes Kai twenty minutes to walk to school.

notes.title: lose one's temper
notes.content: 發脾氣。例：Stay calm. Don't lose your temper.（保持冷靜，別發脾氣。）

notes.title: break down
notes.content: （車輛）拋錨；（機器）故障；（情緒）崩潰。例：The car broke down in the middle of nowhere.（這輛車子在荒郊野外拋錨了。）

notes.title: find meaning in + N / V-ing
notes.content: 表示「在……之中找到意義」。例：He finds meaning in helping younger students.

notes.title: retain sb’s title
notes.content: retain sb’s title：衛冕；保留頭銜。

notes.title: have a word (with sb)
notes.content: （和某人）簡短交談（以尋求／提供建議）。

notes.title: a reason + 疑問詞 why 引導的名詞子句
believe in...
notes.content: 相信……（的存在)；信仰……。例：Michael doesn't believe in Santa Claus.（麥可不相信有聖誕老公公。）

notes.title: have a go at + N / V-ing
notes.content: 表示「嘗試做……」。例：Let me have a go at repairing the bicycle.

notes.title: play a(n) + adj. + role in...
notes.content: 在……方面扮演……的角色。例：Hard work plays an important role in achieving success.（努力在獲致成功方面扮演重要的角色。）
